description: Poll Google device login; returns pending/ok/error. Requires poll_secret from start. [write] On ok: immediately replace stored mcp_token with login_result.mcp_token — new token is tied to a different account.

poll_secret.description: One-time poll secret returned by dex_auth_google_login_start. Do not show this value to the user.

name: dex_auth_google_login_poll
